status: frozen BEFORE any CoT cell was generated
not_a_blind_dataset_validation: Same 300 questions and same gold, unsealed 2026-08-30. What is prospective is the CONDITION (CoT), not the data.

llama.alpha_source: frozen GSM8K workpoint, already used in P3; NOT re-searched and NOT derived from any CoT data
llama.justification: Under No-CoT the same alpha improved over alpha=0 by +6.33 pp (McNemar p=0.00661). The pre-registered prediction is that the sign carries over to CoT. A null or a reversal is a result about condition specificity and is reported with equal prominence.
llama.interaction_status: NOT a locked prediction -- its No-CoT half is already unsealed. Reported descriptively with a CI and excluded from the Holm family.

qwen.alpha_source: frozen GSM8K workpoint, already used in P3; NOT re-searched and NOT derived from any CoT data
qwen.justification: Under No-CoT the same alpha improved over alpha=0 by +16.33 pp (McNemar p=1.41e-08). The pre-registered prediction is that the sign carries over to CoT. A null or a reversal is a result about condition specificity and is reported with equal prominence.
qwen.interaction_status: NOT a locked prediction -- its No-CoT half is already unsealed. Reported descriptively with a CI and excluded from the Holm family.

statistics.primary: dAcc = Acc(CoT+alpha) - Acc(CoT), first_acc, paired per question
statistics.test: exact two-sided McNemar per model, with discordant counts
statistics.holm_family: the two models, m=2, primary metric only
